title: HOLY GHOST FIRE ARISE DANGEROUS MORNING PRAYER THE ENEMY DOESN'T WANT YOU TO PRAY | JOSHUA SELMAN
paragraphs: Fire, not warmth, not a candle, not a controlled, contained, domesticated flame. Fire, the kind that cannot be managed, the kind that does not ask permission to spread. The kind that consumes everything it touches that is not of God. The kind that purifies what it does not consume. The kind that lights up darkness not by negotiating with it, but by simply being what it is. This is what the enemy does not want you to pray.

Not because he fears your emotions, not because he fears your volume, not because he fears your theology. He fears the fire because fire changes the atmosphere before the word is spoken. Because fire consumes the strongholds he spent years building in an instant. Because fire purges what no amount of human effort could clean. Because fire in a life Holy Ghost fire, Acts chapter 2 fire, produces a kind of believer that hell has no strategy against and the enemy knows.

If you ever truly pray this prayer, if you ever truly open yourself to the fire, you will never be the same person again. You will never pray the same prayers. You will never tolerate the same bondages. You will never live the same reduced life, which is why he has been working so hard to keep you away from it. Making the Christian life comfortable enough that you never feel the desperate need for fire. Making the church experience entertaining enough that nobody asked for the Pentecost moment.

Making the prayer meeting manageable enough that nobody is consumed. But today, the fire is being invited and today it is coming. Before we go one sentence further, share this word. Now, not at the end. Someone in your network is living a cold Christian life. They believe, they attend, they serve, but the fire is gone. And a cold fire is a contradiction. A fire that does not burn is not a fire. It is an imitation. Send them this word because what is about to happen in this prayer reignites cold fires.

Send it as an act of love. Send it as an act of warfare. Now, open to Acts chapter 2. I want to take you back to the moment the fire first fell because before we pray for the fire, we need to understand what the fire is, what the fire does, and why it is the most dangerous thing the enemy could face in a believer's life. Acts 2:1-4. And when the day of Pentecost was fully come, they were all with one accord in one place.

And suddenly, there came a sound from heaven as of a rushing mighty wind, and it filled all the house where they were sitting. And there appeared onto them cloven tongues like as of fire, and it sat upon each of them. And they were all filled with the Holy Ghost and began to speak with other tongues as the Spirit gave them utterance. I want to examine four words in this passage that carried the entire revelation. Suddenly, rushing, filled, cloven. Suddenly, there was no gradual warm-up.

There was no 3-week preparation course. There was no incremental increase toward the fire. Suddenly, from nothing to everything. From waiting to fullness. From the upper room of quiet anticipation to the fire of heaven falling. This is the nature of the fire. It does not arrive gradually. It arrives suddenly. Not because it was not building. It was building in the spirit realm for 10 days. But the manifestation, the arrival is sudden. And this is the first thing the enemy fights in your prayer life.

He fights the waiting. He makes the 10 days feel like 10 years. He whispers it is not coming. Nothing is happening. You are not the kind of person this happens to. Because he knows if you stay in the upper room, the suddenly is coming. Thus saith the spirit of God. You have been in the upper room. You have been in the waiting. The fire has felt delayed, but delayed is not denied. The suddenly is at the door. And the 10 days of waiting are about to justify themselves in a single moment. Rushing.

A sound from heaven as of a rushing mighty wind. The Greek is pheromones, violent, forceful, overwhelming in its movement. This was not a gentle breeze. This was not a soft refreshing. This was a force. Something that moved with irresistible momentum. Something that could not be stopped, could not be redirected, could not be managed. There are dimensions to this that the average believer has never accessed. Because most Christians want a manageable Holy Spirit. A Holy Spirit who fits into their schedule.

A Holy Spirit who enhances their life without disrupting it. A Holy Spirit who makes them feel good without making them feel undone. But the Holy Ghost of Acts 2 is a rushing mighty wind. He disrupts. He overturns. He moves with force. He blows away what you thought was important. He rearranges what you had arranged. He fills the house so completely that there is no room for anything that was there before.

John chapter 3 verse 8, Jesus said, "The wind bloweth where it listeth, and thou hearest the sound thereof, but canst not tell whence it cometh and whither it goeth. So is everyone that is born of the spirit. The wind of the spirit goes where he chooses, not where you schedule him, not where you feel comfortable with him going. Where he listed, where he chooses, where he pleases.

And the person born of the spirit, the fire-filled believer, is like the wind, unpredictable to the enemy, moving where the spirit moves, going where the spirit goes, impossible to contain, control, or predict. That is what the enemy is afraid of. Not a believer with a program, a believer who moves like the wind, filled. They were all filled with the Holy Ghost. Not partially filled, not filled in some areas but not others, not filled up to a level that was comfortable, filled.

The Greek is pletho, to fill to capacity, to fill so completely that nothing else can enter. When a vessel is full, there is no room for anything foreign. When a life is filled with the Holy Ghost, there is no room for the spirit of fear, there is no room for the spirit of doubt, there is no room for the spirit of depression, there is no room for the spirit of perversion, there is no room for anything that is not the fire because the fire has taken all the space.

Ephesians chapter 5:18, Paul commands, "And be not drunk with wine, wherein is excess, but be filled with the spirit. Be filled." Present tense, continuous tense. The Greek construction is keep on being filled, not a one-time event, a continuous state. The filling of Pentecost was not meant to be a historical moment you look back on. It was meant to be a daily reality you walk in, a daily refilling, a A reigniting, a daily opening to the fire. And this right here is why the enemy fights the morning prayer.

This is why he fights the prayer meeting. This is why he fights the altar, because every time you come to the fire, you get refilled. And a refilled believer is a dangerous believer. Cloven. Cloven tongues like as of fire. Cloven, divided, split, distributed. The fire did not fall on one person and radiate outward. The fire divided itself and sat upon each of them. Individually, personally. One tongue of fire per person. This is the most personalized moment in scripture.

120 people in the upper room, and God send one tongue of fire for each. Not a collective experience that some individuals participated in. A personal encounter multiplied across every person present. Hear me, this is not theology. This is encounter. The fire has your name on it. Not a generic fire. Not a fire that fell on a great ministry and you can receive overflow. A tongue of fire addressed to you, prepared for you, waiting for you to open your life to it. Now, what does the fire do?

Because the fire is not just experiential. The fire is functional. It accomplishes specific things in a specific order. The fire purifies. Isaiah chapter 6 verse 6 and 7. The seraph took a live coal from the altar and touched Isaiah's lips. And he said, "Lo, this hath touched thy lips, and thine iniquity is taken away, and thy sin purged." The fire that touched Isaiah's lips did not burn him. It purged him. It removed the iniquity. It took away the sin.

The same fire that destroys the enemies works purifies the believers mouth. Malachi chapter 3 verse 2 and 3, he is like a refiner's fire. He shall sit as a refiner and purifier of silver. He shall purify the sons of Levi. The refiner's fire does not destroy the silver. It destroys the dross, the impurity in the silver. And what remains after the fire is purer, more valuable, more reflective of the refiner's image. The fire does not diminish you, it purifies you into your truest form. The fire ignites.

Jeremiah chapter 20 verse 9, Jeremiah says, "But his word was in my heart as a burning fire shut up in my bones and I was weary with forbearing and I could not stay. A burning fire shut up in my bones." The fire of God once it ignites inside you cannot stay contained. Jeremiah tried to stay silent. He was weary with speaking. He said, "I will not make mention of him." But the fire would not cooperate. It burned in his bones until he opened his mouth. This is what the fire does to a voice.

It removes the option of silence. The fire filled believer cannot stay quiet. They cannot sit on what God has given them. The fire makes the word come out. The fire empowers. Luke chapter 24 verse 49, Jesus said, "And behold I send the promise of my father upon you, but tarry ye in the city of Jerusalem until he be endued with power from on high." Endued with power from on high. The Greek is dunamis, explosive, miracle working, earth shaking power.

Not natural courage, not human charisma, not intellectual capacity, dunamis from on high, from the fire. The disciples before Pentecost were afraid. They locked the doors. They hid. Peter denied Jesus three times in front of a servant girl. But after the fire, the same Peter stood before thousands and preached. The same Peter who cowered before a servant girl now stood before the Sanhedrin, Acts 4:13, and they marveled. What changed? Not Peter's natural ability, the fire.

And the fire is available to you, the same fire, the same power, the same Holy Ghost of Acts 2. Jesus is the same yesterday, today, and forever. Hebrews 13:2-8. The promise of the Father has not expired. The fire is still falling, and today it is falling here. Now we pray the prayer the enemy does not want you to pray. I want you to understand this is not a passive prayer. This is not a quiet, dignified, contained prayer. This is a fire-inviting, stronghold-destroying, atmosphere-changing prayer.

And I want you to pray it with everything in you. Not performatively. From the place of genuine hunger, from the place of desperate need, from the recognition that everything you need, everything the assignment requires, is on the other side of the fire. Stand. Lift your hands and pray with me. Father Father Father, we come before you with one request, not a list of items, one thing. The one thing that changes everything else. The one thing that makes all the other prayers effective.

The one thing the enemy is most afraid of in a believer's life. Send the fire. Not fire for display. Not fire for sensation. Fire for transformation. Fire for purification. Fire for empowerment. Fire for the assignment. Lord, we open every area of our lives right now. We do not present the cleaned up version. We do not stand here pretending we have it together. We come with the drawers still visible. We come with the impurity the enemy has been using against us. And we say fire, come. Do what only fire can do.

The fire of purification, come. Like the coal on Isaiah's lips, touch our mouths. Every word spoken out of woundedness that has been creating destruction, purge it. Every vow made in bitterness that has been building walls, burn it. Every agreement with the enemy's narrative about our lives, consume it. Touch our minds with the fire.

Every thought pattern that has been governing us away from God, every stronghold of the mind, 2 Corinthians 10:4, every imaginary edifice the enemy constructed in the thought life, fire, consume it. Reduce it to ash. And in its place, let the mind of Christ arise. 1 Corinthians 2:16, we have the mind of Christ. Fire, replace every stronghold with the mind of Christ. Touch our hearts with the fire. Every hardened place, Ezekiel 36:26, a new heart, a heart of flesh.

Every calcified area of unbelief, burn through by the fire. Every old wound that has become a wall, melted by the fire of his love. The hardness that has been protecting us from pain, but also preventing us from receiving, fire, soften, restore, renew. There is a person under this voice. They have been burned before, not by natural fire by people, by disappointment, by the church, by God as they perceived it. And they have been building a wall around a vulnerable place in their spirit.

So, the fire can never get close enough to hurt them again. But, the wall they built to keep pain out has also been keeping the fire out. The Lord says, "I am not going to burn you. The fire I send does not consume the silver. It consumes the dross. It purifies. It does not destroy. I decree, the wall is coming down in this prayer. Not violently, but willingly. As the fire draws close enough to be felt, the wall yields. And what is on the other side is more beautiful than what was before the wounding.

The fire of ignition come. Lord, let the fire that burned in Jeremiah's bones burn in every bone of every life connected to this prayer. The calling that has gone quiet, ignite it. The gift that has gone cold, ignite it. The voice that has gone silent, ignite it. The vision that has grown faint, ignite IT. I speak to every dormant fire. Every ember that is still alive under the ash of disappointment, I blow on you now. The breath of the spirit on every dying coal, live. Burn. Blaze.

There is a minister I see them, they burned brightly once. They had fire. People felt it when they walked into a room. When they prayed, things happened. When they spoke, hearts moved. But, something came a great disappointment, a prolonged unfruitful season, a wound from people they served, and the fire gradually reduced. They still minister, but they minister from discipline now, not from fire. And they know the difference, and it grieves them. The Lord says, "I have not forgotten the fire I placed in you.

The original fire, the one that burned before the disappointment, it was placed there by me, and what I place I do not remove. You let the ash accumulate over it, but under every layer of ash the coal is still alive. I decree reignition tonight, not eventually, tonight. The fire that burned before the wounding burns again, brighter, purer, more refined by the process. And the next season of ministry, it will be said of them, "Something happened. They are not the same.

The fire is back, and it is hotter than before." The fire of empowerment come. Father, endue us with power from on high. Luke 24:49, the promise of the Father. The dunamis that turned frightened disciples into bold world changers. I receive the dunamis right now, the power to do what the assignment requires. Not natural ability, supernatural enablement.

The power that heals the sick, the power that breaks the yoke, the power that opens blind eyes, natural and spiritual, the power that makes demons flee when the name of Jesus is spoken by fire-filled mouth. Acts 1:8, "But you shall receive power, after that the Holy Ghost is come upon you, and you shall be witnesses unto me both in Jerusalem and in all Judaea and in Samaria and unto the uttermost part of the earth." You shall receive power, not you might receive, not you can apply for. You shall.

It is a covenant promise. It is a divine certainty, and you shall be witnesses. The power produces the witness. The fire produces the testimony. The fullness of the spirit produces the overflow into the world. I receive the power right now, and I receive the assignment that comes with it. Jerusalem, my immediate surroundings, my home, my workplace, my neighborhood. Judea, my wider community, my city, my people group. Samaria, the people I would not naturally reach, the ones beyond my comfort zone.

Uttermost parts, the assignment that goes beyond what I can see from where I stand. Fire, let the witness begin from the closest point and spread outward. Let the Jerusalem of my life feel the fire first. The fire of warfare come. Now, I release the fire as a weapon. Hebrews chapter 12, verse 29, "Our God is a consuming fire." Not was, IS. Present tense. He's the consuming fire right now. And the fire that is in him, he places in his people. When the fire-filled believer prays, they pray with consuming fire.

When the fire-filled believer speaks, the fire goes into the atmosphere. When the fire-filled believer worships, the fire creates an atmosphere that the enemy cannot inhabit. I release the fire of God right now against every stronghold. Fire against the spirit of witchcraft over these lives. Every coven, every altar, every assignment dispatched against the children of God. The fire of God consumes you now. Fire against the spirit of poverty. Every ancestral cause of lack. Every covenant of scarcity.

Every spiritual embargo on the financial advancement of God's servants. The fire of God dismantles you. Now. Fire against the spirit of infirmity. Every sickness that has been given a permanent address in these bodies. Every disease assignment. Every generational affliction. The fire of God drives you out. Now, fire against the spirit of division and strife. Every assignment against the marriages, the families, the ministries connected to this prayer, the fire of God burns through every strand of that assignment.

Now, fire against the spirit of delay. Every principality holding back the breakthrough, every territorial spirit creating resistance against the advancement of these destinies, the fire of God moves you out of the way. Now, there is a person I see them they have been in the same position for 5 years. Not for lack of effort, not for lack of prayer, but there has been a spirit of delay operating like a ceiling. Every time they approach the ceiling, they are pushed back down.

The Lord says, "What human effort could not break, the fire breaks. What years of prayer could not dissolve, the fire dissolves in a moment." I release the fire of God against that ceiling right now. Consume it by fire in the name of Jesus, and I decree the ceiling is gone. And the next step this person takes, they step into a completely different altitude. The fire of consecration come. Lord, let the fire that fell on the altar of Elijah in 1 Kings chapter 18, fall on the altar of our lives.

The altar was drenched three times with water. Everything natural said the fire could not catch. And then Elijah prayed and the fire of the Lord fell and consumed the burnt sacrifice and the wood and the stones and the dust and licked up the water that was in the trench. The fire did not just burn what was on the altar. It consumed everything including the water the enemy used to make the fire impossible. The obstacle the enemy placed to prevent the fire became additional fuel for the fire.

I decree everything the enemy used to try to prevent the fire in your life becomes the accelerant, the water of discouragement fuel, the water of prolonged delay fuel, the water of repeated disappointment fuel, the water of other people's unbelief fuel, all of it consumed by the fire. All of it feeding the blaze. Father, we consecrate ourselves as living altars. Romans 12:1, a living sacrifice, holy, acceptable. We are the altar, we are the sacrifice, and we are asking for the fire. Let it fall.

Let it consume everything on this altar that is not of you. Let it purify what can be purified. Let it empower what needs empowering. Let it ignite what has gone cold. Let it fight what needs to be fought. Holy Ghost fire, arise. Not a small flame, an inferno. Not a local warming, a consuming blaze. Not a temporary experience, a permanent transformation. Arise in every life connected to this prayer. Arise in every home. Arise in every calling. Arise in every ministry. Arise and do what only fire can do.

And we wait for the suddenly because the fire of God does not come gradually. It comes suddenly. Father, we thank you. We thank you that the fire is still falling. 2,000 years after Acts 2, the fire is still being distributed. Cloven, personal, one tongue of fire per life. And tonight there are tongues of fire over every person connected to this prayer. Waiting for the yes. Waiting for the open life. Waiting for the hunger that says I want all of it. Not a portion of the fire, all of it. The siege is over.

The fire has fallen. Not as you felt it as it is. The spirit realm is not governed by what you feel. It is governed by what is true. And what is true right now is the fire of God is in you. The same fire, the same Holy Ghost, the same Acts 2 fullness. Walk into your favor, it has been waiting. On the other side of the fire, in the cleared atmosphere, where the strongholds used to be, there is space now. Space for the destiny, space for the calling, space for the fullness.

Your destiny is preserved by the blood and ignited by the fire. The blood protects what God built. The fire empowers what God built to operate. You needed both. You have both. I decree this week is not ordinary. This week you carry the fire. Everywhere you go the atmosphere shifts. Every room you enter the temperature changes. Every person you encounter they feel something different about you. Something they cannot name. Something that makes them lean in when you speak.

Something that makes their burdens feel lighter in your presence. That something is the fire. The enemy assembled against your life this morning and then you prayed this prayer and the fire fell. And the enemy is not assembling against a person anymore. He is assembling against a blaze and fire does not fear what comes against it. Fire consumes it. From this altar you go as a fire carrier, not a program carrier, not a theology carrier, a fire carrier. The one in whom the rushing mighty wind has moved.

The one upon whom the cloven tongue has sat. The one who has been filled plateau to capacity. It is done. The fire has fallen. The purification has begun. The ignition has happened. The empowerment has been received. The strongholds are burning and hell has received notice of what it is now dealing with. Holy Ghost fire has arisen in you right now today. Amen and amen.
